## Yakusuru 1.1.4, clearer install status

The Install components screen now shows where every part stands, at a glance.

### What's new

- **A proper Status column.** Every component lines up under one Status heading, with a coloured dot, a plain state (Installed, Not installed, Not running, Not available) and the version or location underneath.
- **No more rows stuck on checking.** Re-check now always finishes. If something can't be checked, that row says so in red with the reason, instead of staying blank, and the other rows still show their status.

### Upgrading

Download **Yakusuru-v1.1.4.zip** below, unzip it, and replace your old Yakusuru folder (or the app in Applications on a Mac). Your settings, glossary, API keys and downloaded models are kept.
